title: Clean full sentence answer styling
body:
- Enhanced in-game answer card layout: the response now renders inside the classic green or red badge as a single natural sentence (e.g. "✓ Yes, the country has direct coastline access to the sea." or "✗ No, the country does not border Germany.").
- Removed awkward secondary containers and text wrapping for a cleaner, unified presentation.
- Your saved game progress, daily streaks, and question and guess limits are unchanged.
